parts.text:
The results of the $\alpha$-particle scattering experiment led to the development of the nuclear model for the atom.

State the results that suggested that most of the mass of the atom is concentrated in a very small region and most of the atom is empty space.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.part_stem: The discovery of a particle with an unusual charge was an important step in the development of the theory of quarks. The particle is a hadron with a mass of $2.19 \times 10^{-27} \text{kg}$ and a charge of $+2e$, where $e$ is the elementary charge.
parts.text: Calculate the mass, in $u$, of the particle. Give your answer to three significant figures.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Determine a possible quark composition of a hadron with a charge of $+2e$. Explain your reasoning.
